The '''Vilonis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell]], [[Vish sector/Legends|Vish]], [[Druess sector/Legends|Druess]], and [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] apparently maintained a large presence in the Vilonis [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and it was the location of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nomlis III]], where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Bretie Facility]] based its production center for the [[TIE Experimental Project]]. Prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the facility preyed upon commercial shipping in the [[Belat system/Legends|Belat system]], one of many sites where TIE Experimentals were tested through raids on civilian shipping until the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] destroyed the Imperial project base.<ref name="XWA" />
